Container.Name: NexusBackup-Control
Container.Overview: Nexus Backup control plane and local dashboard. This is one half of the self-contained Nexus Backup installation; install NexusBackup-Agent after this container. Control owns the local SQLite database, schedules, UI and authentication, but has no backup-storage or FUSE access.
Container.Requires: Install the matching NexusBackup-Agent template after Control. Both containers intentionally use host networking for simple local-only control/agent communication.

Config.Name: Control appdata
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database, local auth and generated control secrets.

Config.Name: Shared runtime
Config.Description: Small shared runtime directory used to hand the generated agent token to the local agent. Use exactly the same host path in the Agent template.

Config.Name: Agent config
Config.Description: Read-only view of the Agent config directory so the dashboard can expose sanitized local configuration. Use exactly the same host path as /config in the Agent template.

Config.Name: Agent ID
Config.Description: Bundled local agent identity. Keep this identical in both templates.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional explicit external http(s) origin, for example https://backup.example.test, when Nexus is behind a trusted reverse proxy. Used for workstation installer URLs and Secure-cookie policy. Forwarded Host/Proto headers are intentionally ignored.
